records.subject: PEDOT:PSS
records.object: Probably highest thermoelectric performance among reported organic polymer and composite thermoelectric materials
records.quote: So far, in all of the reported organic polymer and composite thermoelectric materials, poly(3,4-ethylene dioxyethiophene):poly (styrene sulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS) is probably the most frequently studied and most successful system with the highest thermoelectric performance.
records.conditions: Qualified as 'probably'; among materials reported so far

records.subject: PEDOT:PSS
records.object: Thermoelectric properties distinctly below maximum inorganic counterparts
records.quote: Nevertheless, compared with inorganic thermoelectric materials, the thermoelectric properties of PEDOT:PSS is distinctly lower than the maximum value of the inorganic counterparts.
records.conditions: Compared with maximum thermoelectric properties of inorganic materials

records.subject: Doping/de-doping strategies, including second doping/de-doping, acid or alkali treatment, and ionic-liquid treatment
records.quote: Here, we present a summarization of the recent progress in the development of strategies to significantly enhance the thermoelectric properties of PEDOT:PSS developed so far.
context_quotes: First, the advances of the doping/de-doping strategies, such as second doping/de-doping, acid or alkali treatment, and treating by ionic liquid, are focused in details.
records.conditions: Reviewed strategy family; no individual treatment effect or mechanism specified

records.subject: Tuning crystalline and orientation aggregation microstructures
records.quote: Here, we present a summarization of the recent progress in the development of strategies to significantly enhance the thermoelectric properties of PEDOT:PSS developed so far.
context_quotes: Then, the recent developments of three types of boosting strategies, i.e. tuning of aggregation structures (including crystalline and orientation microstructures), construction of PEDOT nano-micro structures (for example, nanospheres, nanorods, micro- or nano-tubes and nanofibers), and fabrication of thermoelectric composites with inorganic particles such as carbon nanotubes and graphene nanoplatelets, are concentrated.

records.subject: Fabricating thermoelectric composites with inorganic particles such as carbon nanotubes and graphene nanoplatelets

records.subject: Successfully developed PEDOT:PSS enhancement strategies

records.subject: Fe2+/Fe3+ in DMSO with a small amount of 19 M aqueous LiCl
records.conditions: 20 °C ≤ T ≤ 40 °C; alpha = dV/dT
records.quote: The electrochemical Seebeck coefficient (alpha = dV/dT; V and T are the redox potential and temperature, respectively) is important parameter for thermoelectric conversion.
context_quotes: Here, we found that alpha of Fe2+/Fe3+ in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) with small amount of 19 M LiCl aqueous solution exhibits a crossover behavior from 1.4 mV K-1 (20 degrees C <= T <= 40 degrees C) to approximate to 0 mV K-1 (50 degrees C <= T <= 80 degrees C).

records.subject: Polysulfide
records.quote: In this work, a thermocell that utilizes abundant polysulfide as redox species was demonstrated for the first time. 1-Butyl-1-methylpyrrolidinium polysulfide [(P-14)(2)S-3] was synthesized, and the redox species were prepared by the addition of sulfur to the (P-14)(2)S-3 solution in DMSO.
